name: TiDB Cloud Essential Dynamic Tracker (For instances created on or after July 1, 2026)
description: This dashboard provides a high-level overview for TiDB Cloud Essential instances created on or after July 1, 2026.

rawConfiguration.text:
This dashboard provides a high-level overview for TiDB Cloud Essential instances created on or after July 1, 2026.

Further reading on TiDB monitoring: [Metrics available to New Relic](https://docs.pingcap.com/tidbcloud/monitor-new-relic-integration#metrics-available-to-newrelic)

Clone this template dashboard to make changes and add your own graph widgets.

# Performance Overview

Database performance and storage metrics for TiDB Cloud Essential.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT (average(`tidb_cloud.db_database_time`) * cardinality(`tidb_cloud.db_database_time`)) AS 'Total' FROM Metric WHERE ('*' IN ({{instance_name}}) OR instance_name IN ({{instance_name}})) AND ('*' IN ({{instance_id}}) OR instance_id IN ({{instance_id}})) SINCE 24 HOURS AGO TIMESERIES

SELECT (average(`tidb_cloud.db_database_time`) * cardinality(`tidb_cloud.db_database_time`)) FROM Metric WHERE ('*' IN ({{instance_name}}) OR instance_name IN ({{instance_name}})) AND ('*' IN ({{instance_id}}) OR instance_id IN ({{instance_id}})) FACET sql_type LIMIT MAX SINCE 24 HOURS AGO TIMESERIES

SELECT (average(`tidb_cloud.db_query_per_second`) * cardinality(`tidb_cloud.db_query_per_second`)) AS 'Total' FROM Metric WHERE ('*' IN ({{instance_name}}) OR instance_name IN ({{instance_name}})) AND ('*' IN ({{instance_id}}) OR instance_id IN ({{instance_id}})) SINCE 24 HOURS AGO TIMESERIES

SELECT average(`tidb_cloud.db_average_query_duration`) AS 'Average' FROM Metric WHERE ('*' IN ({{instance_name}}) OR instance_name IN ({{instance_name}})) AND ('*' IN ({{instance_id}}) OR instance_id IN ({{instance_id}})) SINCE 24 HOURS AGO TIMESERIES

SELECT average(`tidb_cloud.db_average_query_duration`) FROM Metric WHERE ('*' IN ({{instance_name}}) OR instance_name IN ({{instance_name}})) AND ('*' IN ({{instance_id}}) OR instance_id IN ({{instance_id}})) FACET sql_type LIMIT MAX SINCE 24 HOURS AGO TIMESERIES

SELECT (average(`tidb_cloud.db_failed_queries`) * cardinality(`tidb_cloud.db_failed_queries`)) AS 'Total' FROM Metric WHERE ('*' IN ({{instance_name}}) OR instance_name IN ({{instance_name}})) AND ('*' IN ({{instance_id}}) OR instance_id IN ({{instance_id}})) SINCE 24 HOURS AGO TIMESERIES

SELECT (average(`tidb_cloud.db_failed_queries`) * cardinality(`tidb_cloud.db_failed_queries`)) FROM Metric WHERE ('*' IN ({{instance_name}}) OR instance_name IN ({{instance_name}})) AND ('*' IN ({{instance_id}}) OR instance_id IN ({{instance_id}})) FACET type LIMIT MAX SINCE 24 HOURS AGO TIMESERIES

SELECT (average(`tidb_cloud.db_row_storage_used_bytes`) * cardinality(`tidb_cloud.db_row_storage_used_bytes`)) AS 'Total' FROM Metric WHERE ('*' IN ({{instance_name}}) OR instance_name IN ({{instance_name}})) AND ('*' IN ({{instance_id}}) OR instance_id IN ({{instance_id}})) SINCE 24 HOURS AGO TIMESERIES

# Connections

Connection state at TiDB Cloud Essential instance scope.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT (average(`tidb_cloud.db_total_connection`) * cardinality(`tidb_cloud.db_total_connection`)) AS 'Total' FROM Metric WHERE ('*' IN ({{instance_name}}) OR instance_name IN ({{instance_name}})) AND ('*' IN ({{instance_id}}) OR instance_id IN ({{instance_id}})) SINCE 24 HOURS AGO TIMESERIES

SELECT (average(`tidb_cloud.db_active_connections`) * cardinality(`tidb_cloud.db_active_connections`)) AS 'Total' FROM Metric WHERE ('*' IN ({{instance_name}}) OR instance_name IN ({{instance_name}})) AND ('*' IN ({{instance_id}}) OR instance_id IN ({{instance_id}})) SINCE 24 HOURS AGO TIMESERIES

SELECT (average(`tidb_cloud.db_disconnections`) * cardinality(`tidb_cloud.db_disconnections`)) FROM Metric WHERE ('*' IN ({{instance_name}}) OR instance_name IN ({{instance_name}})) AND ('*' IN ({{instance_id}}) OR instance_id IN ({{instance_id}})) FACET result LIMIT MAX SINCE 24 HOURS AGO TIMESERIES

# Request Unit

This panel shows RU usage for TiDB Cloud Essential instances.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT (average(`tidb_cloud.resource_manager_resource_request_unit_total`) * cardinality(`tidb_cloud.resource_manager_resource_request_unit_total`)) FROM Metric WHERE ('*' IN ({{instance_name}}) OR instance_name IN ({{instance_name}})) AND ('*' IN ({{instance_id}}) OR instance_id IN ({{instance_id}})) FACET resource_group LIMIT MAX SINCE 24 HOURS AGO TIMESERIES

# Changefeed

CDC metrics supported for TiDB Cloud Essential. Panels stay empty when CDC is not enabled.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT max(`tidb_cloud.cdc_changefeed_latency`) FROM Metric WHERE ('*' IN ({{instance_name}}) OR instance_name IN ({{instance_name}})) AND ('*' IN ({{instance_id}}) OR instance_id IN ({{instance_id}})) FACET changefeed_id LIMIT MAX SINCE 24 HOURS AGO TIMESERIES
